title: Change Order Fee Card — Design Studio Selections Packages
content:
Change orders on a Design Studio Selections file are counted and priced against the package figures below.

| Package | Buyer-requested change orders carrying no fee | Package change order fee (USD) | Package post-structural change order fee (USD) | Most buyer-requested change orders per file | Builder-error change orders free and not counted |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Studio Essentials | 0 | 350.00 | 750.00 | 3 | Yes |
| Studio Classic | 1 | 350.00 | 750.00 | 3 | Yes |
| Studio Select | 1 | 400.00 | 850.00 | 4 | Yes |
| Studio Designer | 2 | 450.00 | 950.00 | 5 | Yes |
| Studio Signature | 2 | 500.00 | 1000.00 | 6 | Yes |
| Studio Atelier | 3 | 500.00 | 1000.00 | 8 | Yes |

**What each column means**

- *Buyer-requested change orders carrying no fee* — the package's free change orders.
- *Package change order fee* — the change order fee for a change order written while the file is in selection.
- *Package post-structural change order fee* — the change order fee for a change order written after structural close.
- *Most buyer-requested change orders per file* — the package's maximum number of change orders.
- *Builder-error change orders free and not counted* — whether a change order made to correct a studio or builder error carries no fee and does not count toward the limits; the answer is Yes for every package.

**Reading across the card**

- Studio Essentials is the one package with no fee-free buyer-requested change order; Studio Atelier has three.
- The post-structural fee is above the in-selection fee on every package.
